mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, with SPX 20-day returns positive in more than 50% of such cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing contraction regime (INDPRO < 100), a decline in industrial production signals supply chain disruptions that increase corporate input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A positive year-over-year growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 YoY growth is positive, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, with SPX 20-day returns positive in more than 50% of such cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom regime (HOUST > 1050), a sustained increase in housing starts drives positive consumer sentiment and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1050, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02.
